title: a-summons-shows-its-pickup
owner: CC (grammar + pickup door + probe + definition section + crossings); Akien (the ruling: decision 2026-08-07-the-ticket-is-the-source-period, confirmed same day with 'I think we're /sorted approved and so on'
intention: EVERY SUMMONS SHOWS ITS PICKUP LIFECYCLE ON THE TICKET ITSELF. A -ME state gains two phases stated once at the grammar level — waiting (summoned, nobody picked it up) and in-process (picked up, the pickup journaled as actor + time) — expressed as cursor annotation ([BUILDME:waiting] -> [BUILDME:in-process]), never as doubled table rows, so every summons in every class inherits the lifecycle including classes not yet written (his 'and so on': DESIGNME-WAITING before DESIGNME exists). Terminals take no phase: if the state summons somebody, it has a pickup; PROVED summons nobody. The build lands in press_office/WorkflowDefinition.md FIRST (its own living-definition rule), then cairn/tools/base/transitions.py: the phase in _STATE_RE and the Workflow dataclass, parse refusals (phase off-cursor, on a rest or terminal, unknown phase), render stamping :waiting on summons arrival, and a pickup() door beside emit (the emit_migrated precedent) that advances waiting -> in-process and journals through the same projector tail as every crossing.
why: Akien, 2026-08-07, on who would flip a status marker: 'the tester picks up the ticket and all those different things have to know what to push and that's going to make a difference. that sounds stinky. because thats the opposite of good encapsulation. somebody has to know something special about somebody else. the ticket is THE SOURCE PERIOD.' The lived symptom is the board conversation that triggered it: 'verify says pending on WHAT?' — surfaces answering pending/in-flight/done from private knowledge instead of deriving all three from the one cursor (waiting=pending, in-process=in-flight, crossed=done). Law 5: the pickup is part of the voyage and lives at the voyage's address. Law 1: the board derives standing instead of every actor re-tracking it.
traces_to: Law 5 — intent, voyage, proofs share an address; the pickup is voyage and rides the cursor, not an actor's head
Law 1 — pending/in-flight/done derived from the cursor once, never re-derived per surface
Law 6 — the pickup is a journaled act through the one door, not an ambient flag
decision 2026-08-07-the-ticket-is-the-source-period — the ruling, confirmed with his verbatim

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam@v2's registered set: entry gate at the BUILDME forward crossing (cast ticket + berthed chart chain + this ticket's intent_berth and sorted_berth); build gate at the PROVEME forward crossing (build_inspector's sieves over cairn/tools/base); emission gate at the WATCHME forward crossing (cairn/tools/base/watchme_spec.py — spec below, probe berthed and armed before the crossing); exit gate at the PROVED entry (proved_answers_the_chart — this ticket IS chart-claimed, so the verdict artifact answering every criterion is owed, no clean-by-absence); proof gate: teeth beside the code in cairn/tools/base/proofs/, extending test_transitions.py rather than paralleling it.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a bare legacy cursor fails to parse (phase must default None — 88 standing histories stay readable, no rewrite, no v3); a phase parses anywhere but the cursor segment, or on a rest or terminal, or an unknown phase word passes; pickup() fires on a rest or fires twice; render fails to stamp :waiting on a summons arrival; the standing proofs (test_transitions.py, test_watchme_vocabulary.py, test_v2_migration.py) go red; the board tri-state cannot be derived from cursor phase alone; or the boat stands short of PROVED when this ticket claims done.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read at: the first live pickup in anger (the watch's clear); the first board surface that derives tri-state from phases (the ruling's named-but-unspawned consumer arriving); per-class pickup-enforcement becoming a real dial (the single-actor-collapse assumption's expiry); and when the hand-set floor of 12 arrivals becomes tunable (learns-its-gates IOU, named at the cast).

children: none, because the build is one grammar extension + one door + one probe + one definition section, all under this ticket at one pair of addresses (cairn/tools/base, press_office). The board surface that will derive tri-state from phases is named in the ruling's context and deliberately not spawned: a manager for an empty room until a surface asks.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(a-pickup-is-witnessed) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: every pulse reaching cairn/tools/base's shim — the probe walks state.json cursors and history.json records across cairn/ and skills/ components (files only: no device, no bus, no network), counting summons arrivals stamped :waiting against pickup records journaled through the door. Fires when >= 12 phased summons arrivals stand with ZERO pickup records ever journaled — the grammar shipped and the pickup door is decorative The owning component's own records are excluded from both counts (see enough).
watchme.enough: cleared by ONE witnessed pickup — a journaled pickup record (actor + time) advancing a summons waiting -> in-process through the door. An EXISTENCE claim — with the owning component (cairn/tools/base) excluded from the corpus, both counts, both clauses: the voyage that built the door also sails through it, and the author's own pickup clearing the watch at birth is the home-field failure the sibling probe (does_optional_mean_never_carried) measured live on 2026-07-30. The question is whether anyone ELSE ever comes through.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier — phased-arrival count, pickup count, and the standing :waiting cursors BY component path, so the zero's two readings (single-actor collapse absorbing pickups into crossings / the door unknown to its callers) arrive as a measured fork, complete on the first pass
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the claim is a prediction that a journaled pickup phase turns 'who has this' from tribal knowledge into cursor data, and a prediction that did not hold belongs in the tree that remembers what killed which
watchme.consumer: Akien, through the owner's gate. The probe deposits and pokes; whichever fork the zero turns out to be (teach callers the door, or rule single-actor collapse the honest normal and retire the watch), the back-edge is his act (Law 6).
